change_summary: Corrected media-source error retry and same-element resume documentation in response to independent Review findings R1 and R2.
decisions: On a user retry when audio.error is present, call audio.load() to clear the retained media error, then call audio.play() in that same click. Ordinary resume does not reload the source.

The original audio double did not model persistent HTMLMediaElement.error, so it falsely allowed retry without a load/reset. The new regression double keeps code 4 until load clears it and rejects play while the error remains.
Documented that same-element resume may play buffered audio behind the live edge; stream timing awaits host observation.
tests: npm test passed 5/5 on 2026-10-03 with localhost socket access: normal Play/Pause/buffering/resume, play rejection, retained source-error reset and retry, late rejection after Pause, and real HTTP MCP tool/resource integration.
The retained-error test rejects play while error.code=4 remains and verifies that retry calls load once, clears the error before play, and reaches playing after the media event.
The normal resume test confirms no unnecessary load call; git diff --check passed before commit.
ambiguities: Whether same-element resume remains at the live edge or plays buffered content depends on browser and stream behavior; no timing claim is made.
blockers: No connected ChatGPT test host or public HTTPS endpoint is available. ChatGPT UI rendering, audible playback, media/CSP behavior, and host PiP remain unobserved; README.md gives the manual checks.
